_comment: CCV-L23's declared table (DA rev 131 form; DA 130, OI-184's lag-1 option) for ooe_redir.sv (the two-cycle form retired, OA 492): each slot's redirect warp and epoch, written in its resolution's cycle and read by the send when the slot has waited (its checkpoint, mask, target and stay held in ooe_rob_w's own register, OA-487).

ew_cq04h.why: ooe_redir's waiting redirects' warps (S words, one a slot): a resolution writes its slot's word from ooe_decrx's cq03h warp; the send, at its own stage, reads a word through pw_cq03h only when that slot waited, an arriving slot's being the ports'. Neither a loop's back edge nor a later copy on the reader's pipeline. Assertion hd_read_not_written (no word read in its write cycle). Signed in OA 491.

ee_cq04h.why: As ew_cq04h, for each waiting redirect's epoch (ooe_decrx's ep1_cq03h). Its hazard (OA 491): a warp's epoch advancing while its redirect waits; a later squash of the slot rewrites the word (superseded), and the redirect is never sent with an epoch an advance has passed. Checked in the rob bench (test/ooe/rob_tb.cpp): every send carries its warp's current epoch, or the next while its own squash is due, and every RTL send equals the model's; control redir-epoch (the epoch from before the advance) must fail, and does. Signed in OA 491.
